interruptedBody: Restart the guard to resume monitoring.
permissionBody: SignalGuard uses audible Time Sensitive notifications for connectivity incidents and interrupted monitoring. Allow notifications, then keep alerts, sounds and Time Sensitive delivery enabled in iOS Settings.
privacy: SignalGuard has no account, analytics or telemetry. Connectivity checks make minimal HTTPS requests solely to verify Internet access and do not include SignalGuard user or device identifiers.
privacyLocal: History stays on this iPhone and is excluded from cloud backups.
language: Follows the language selected for SignalGuard in iOS Settings.
about: A free tool for people on call. Internet access and cellular network registration are checked independently. Registration does not prove that a telephone call can reach you.
limits: iOS can stop monitoring at any time. A pre-scheduled local notification warns when the native monitor stops confirming connectivity. iOS controls notification delivery; Focus, silent mode and device power can limit alerts.
advancedHelp: Choose what triggers an alert. Keep at least one enabled.
watchdogAlways: The monitoring-health watchdog is always enabled.
fixedTiming: Failures must persist for 60 seconds. Unacknowledged incidents remind you every 5 minutes.
lockedSettings: Stop the active guard before changing monitoring settings.
noHistoryBody: Completed guards and connectivity interruptions appear here.
clearBody: This permanently removes previous sessions from this iPhone.
diagnosticHelp: For device testing only. Simulations use the real native loop and local notifications. Restore real readings after testing.
shortTimingHelp: 10-second grace · 30-second reminders · 18-second watchdog. Set before starting a guard. Release builds exclude these controls and native methods.
endHelp: An earlier clock time means tomorrow. Maximum duration: 24 hours.
safetyNote: Connectivity checks cannot guarantee receipt of a telephone call.
buildRequired: Install an iOS development build to use the native guard.
nativeUnavailable: Native monitoring is unavailable. Install the SignalGuard iOS development build.
iosRequired: SignalGuard requires an iPhone with iOS 26 or later.
internetUnavailable: Internet connectivity could not be confirmed.
cellularUnavailable: No cellular network is currently registered.
notificationsRequired: Enable notification authorization, alerts and sounds to use SignalGuard.
timeSensitiveRequired: Enable Time Sensitive notifications for SignalGuard in iOS Settings.
conditionsRequired: Keep at least one monitoring condition enabled.
storageUnavailable: Local history could not be saved safely. Monitoring cannot start.
taskUnavailable: The iOS monitoring task could not be registered. Reinstall the build and try again.
startFailed: iOS could not start monitoring immediately. The guard has not started. Try again while the app is open.
monitorInterrupted: SignalGuard can no longer confirm your connectivity. Restart the guard explicitly.
notificationsChanged: Notification delivery is no longer enabled. Monitoring has been interrupted.
notificationSchedulingFailed: The monitoring notification could not be scheduled. The guard has been interrupted.
preflightFailed: Setup could not be confirmed. Resolve the issues shown before starting.
invalidEnd: Choose an end time within the next 24 hours.
alreadyActive: A guard is already running or starting.
foregroundRequired: Keep SignalGuard open while you press START GUARD.
settingsLocked: Stop the guard before changing these settings.
guardRequired: Start a guard before using simulations.
completionNotificationFailed: The guard completed, but its completion notification could not be delivered.
genericFailure: SignalGuard could not confirm the operation. Check setup and try again.
simulationActive: Development simulation is active. Restore real readings before use.
clockChanged: The iPhone’s clock changed while monitoring. Restart the guard to confirm its end time.
